generalAbilities.name: Recall Reflection
generalAbilities.description: A ledalusca can recall and replay any reflection ever cast on its surface, although it must still Seek to consciously notice fine or significant details.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shell Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The ledalusca takes physical damage from an attack

Requirements The ledalusca's shell is frozen (see Freeze Shell)

Effect The ledalusca angles their shell to absorb the blow, gaining resistance 5 to the triggering damage. If they take bludgeoning or fire damage after applying this resistance, their frozen shell shatters until they freeze a new one.

offensiveAbilities.name: Freeze Shell
offensiveAbilities.description:
The ledalusca freezes their surface into a translucent, faintly colored ice sculpture matching the mirror image of a Medium creature or object they have seen before. While in this form, instead of a wave, they have the following Strike:

Melee a ice shell +10/+5/+0, Damage 1d4 Cold Damage damage

The physical damage is a type that matches the new shape of the ledalusca's frozen shell. The ledalusca can revert to their liquid form by taking this action again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hold Still
offensiveAbilities.description: Until the next time they act, the ledaluca appears to be either an ice sculpture (if under the effects of Freeze Shell) or a pool of still water (if not). They have an automatic result of 28 on Deception checks and DCs to pass as what they appear to be.

offensiveAbilities.name: Push
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Push in its damage entry

Effect The monster attempts to Shove the creature. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the monster's multiple attack penalty. If Push lists a distance, change the distance the creature is pushed on a success to that distance.
